text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Bamboo 
Memory, we bumped into Daitaku Helios and 
Gold City.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh~ if it isn't Helios and City! What're 
you guys doing all the way out here?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Probably the same as you seniors. We were 
just hanging out together."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
A random encounter like this is totally 
destiny! For now, let's collab with Bamboo 
and the others and get these vibes soaring 
high☆

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wh-what's up!? What did Helios just say!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
She means play together. Well, it's 
true... Bamboo-senpai and I are roommates, 
but we haven't hung out much, so maybe 
this is a good chance.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That's definitely gonna be fun, 
boss! All right, let's all four of us roll 
out!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
First off, let's chill here☆ Bamboo, hit 
us with your committee head recs, please!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
My recommendation, boss? Well, it's a 
super classy joint, so maybe go for a vibe 
that's even classier than usual—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Then... how about this "Super Giga-Carrot 
Hamburg Steak Eating Challenge"!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Taking on a challenge like that right off 
the bat!? Bamboo-senpai never wavers, does 
she...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Always going my way-way☆ Bamboo is 
seriously living it up♪ Guess I gotta ride 
this wave too~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I'm not totally sure what this is, 
but count me in! Heheh! The second I saw 
the menu, I just knew it was the one!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
“—Let's go, let's go, fire it up!! Full 
power, full throttle, 
one-two-three-four!!!!”

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"When you sing this kind of song, 
Bamboo-senpai, it just looks so totally 
cool on you."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo is the best! Hype levels maxed☆ 
Like a super passionate cheer captain?! 
Way to gooo!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a bunch~!! Aww yeah yeah yeah! 
Pushing past my limits, one more tiiime~!! 
...Heheheh!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"So this is that nail salon everyone's 
talkin' about! Huh, neat, you can even put 
letters on 'em!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Then 'Grit,' 'Hot-Blooded,' and 
'Friendship'! I wanna put passionate words 
in brush calligraphy style!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Bamboo's sense is peak divine! It's 
like soaring~! I'm gonna do the same☆

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That makes quite an impact... Who knows, 
it might even become a trend thanks to 
Bamboo-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
For real!? Think my sense of style could 
take the world by storm!?
choice_data_list:
It's certainly cutting-edge fashion 
sense... I think?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
!! You think so? You really think so~?! 
Hehehe! Trainer, you feel the same way 
too~?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Then with my cutting-edge sense! I'll come 
up with a super cool nail design for you 
too, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Leave eveerything to me, boss!! I'm gonna 
hook you up with some absolutely 
super-duper nail art~!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
A red stone for hot-blooded power! A thick 
chain for an unbreakable bond! And... 
colorful stones to represent my rivals!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Right in the middle, we'll do an 
ultra-fusion with a giant horseshoe-style 
ring representing our dream! And that 
completes the ultimate, coolest nail combo 
eva~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no, no, no... Surely the senior 
trainers and instructors would get mad at 
us, right...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Gold City, I somehow managed to 
avoid getting nails that look like 
late-game claw equipment that gives a 
massive stat boost...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, seriously super hype and so lit! 
Hanging out with Bamboo is totally wicked☆

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It was quite chaotic, but fun. Well, see 
you at the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yep! See you back at school! Don't break 
curfew, okay~?
choice_data_list:
Man, she was really getting into it, 
though.

She was really getting into it, wasn't 
she?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ahh... heheh. Guess I got a little 
too carried away, huh?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "...Wait, Trainer, are you mad at me...?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That's a relief~. Man, really 
sorry about that!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...I've always been like that~. As soon 
as someone praises me, my switch just 
flips right on."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I'll show you something even more 
amazing! ...Man, I always get carried away 
like that, huh~."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Because of that, even if I get praised at 
first, I end up getting a huge earful in 
the end... Hahaha. It's totally 
embarrassing, honestly...
choice_data_list: Being able to go all out is a great thing!
Being able to go all out is a great thing!

Don't worry, I'll stop you if you go too 
far.
It's okay, I'll stop you if you overdo it!

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! If we're gonna do it, might as 
well go all out! All right! Starting 
tomorrow, I'll take what I learned today 
and write motivational words on my nails!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once she sets her mind to it, there's no 
stopping her. Bamboo Memory's tendency to 
rush headlong might just be because she's 
too earnest—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
As expected of you, Trainer-san, so 
dependable! If it ever looks like I'm 
going out of control, don't hold back, lay 
into me and set me straight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Though she might go off the rails at 
times, Bamboo Memory was truly earnest.
